architecture_resolution.value: Fixed-resolution variant uses the standard ViT architecture with learned positional embedding; patch size 16 and image resolution 256 (image representation sequence length 256). The B/16 256px row in the results table corresponds to ViT B/16 with Res.=256 and Seq.=256. Fixed-resolution checkpoints are obtained by resuming from the sequence-length-256/patch-16 checkpoint at 95% of training, resizing the positional embedding to the target sequence length, and resuming at the target resolution.
